issue_request: FHIR-6956 asked to correct the DSTU1 Encounter Status Management sentence from "This could be done my scanning" to "This could be done by scanning" in section 5.18.1.1. Jira status is Published, resolution is Persuasive, change impact is non-substantive, and the issue was applied for DSTU1.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 5436. Git commit 29293547777d4a0b0fc6586dfa61951701ca7b1e (#6956, git-svn build@5436) changed source/encounter/encounter-introduction.xml from "This could be done my scanning through all the versions of the encounter" to "This could be done by scanning through all the versions of the encounter." The adjacent "throuh" typo in the same original sentence had already been corrected by e9f31be63466093ed84483ed96cc02ef89639095 (#7650, git-svn build@5432).
additional_context: Encounter is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini's [resources] encounter=Encounter entry. Later Encounter status-management work in dc223befbe35bc659d657b3124bc6a70d697583d (FHIR-13702) rewrote the surrounding narrative but preserved the corrected "by scanning through" wording, now as "This could be done by scanning through all the resource history versions of the encounter." The combined branch already contains no-change audit commits for same-line typo issues FHIR-7650 and FHIR-7896. Searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence records that change the Jira/source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because source/encounter/encounter-introduction.xml already says "This could be done by scanning through all the resource history versions of the encounter," and current-source searches found no remaining "my scanning" or "scanning throuh" typo in the Encounter source.
